# Generated by tools/port_missing.py from the Vic2 DoD decision files the content audit found missing.

dod_buy_athesia = {
	is_shown = {
		OR = { c:NBG ?= this c:PLA ?= this c:VIN ?= this c:DNG ?= this c:AMA ?= this c:LOT ?= this }
		exists = c:VEN
		c:VEN = { owns_entire_state_region = STATE_FLORIDA }
		NOT = { has_variable = dod_buy_athesia }
	}
	possible = {
		is_at_war = no
		country_rank >= rank_value:major_power
	}
	when_taken = {
		set_variable = dod_buy_athesia
		dod_buy_offer = { STATE = STATE_FLORIDA SELLER = VEN }
	}
	ai_chance = { value = 50 }
}

dod_buy_curonian_colonies = {
	is_shown = {
		country_rank >= rank_value:great_power
		exists = c:KRL
		c:KRL = { any_scope_state = { NOT = { state_region = s:STATE_COURLAND } } }
		NOT = { has_variable = dod_buy_curonian }
	}
	possible = {
		is_at_war = no
	}
	when_taken = {
		set_variable = dod_buy_curonian
		c:KRL = { random_scope_state = { limit = { NOT = { state_region = s:STATE_COURLAND } } state_region = { save_scope_as = dod_cur_region } } }
		save_scope_as = dod_buy_buyer
		c:KRL = { save_scope_as = dod_buy_seller set_variable = { name = dod_buy_region value = scope:dod_cur_region } trigger_event = { id = dod_buy.1 days = 14 } }
	}
	ai_chance = { value = 50 }
}
